subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it render only trusted structured image blocks and media-store references?
rationale: The feature is useful, but this PR crosses from tool-result text into host-local file reads and terminal graphics output, which is a product and security-boundary choice automation should not settle.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to consume current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained MEDIA path reads
options.body: Keep the file-read shape only with an explicit trusted-root policy, tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in the canonical issue while closing or parking this stale draft until a maintainer sponsors the boundary.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to consume current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI renderer introduction and the image_generate feature history make this the best available routing candidate for the product/security boundary decision.
